buffer.text:
EURO 10 🇪🇺 — Week ending 12 Nov

We added up the Spotify weekly charts of Italy, France, Germany, the UK, the Netherlands, Belgium and Poland: rap only, 101 points minus chart position. Result: French rap takes all ten spots. Vacra's "Fille à Papa" with La Rvfleuze is #1 with 196 points (#1 in France, #5 in Belgium), and Mauvais djo holds five of the ten. Kid Yugi (#1 in Italy) and 730 Huncho (#1 in Poland) stop at 100: one country isn't enough.

🎧 Track: Fille à Papa – Vacra feat. La Rvfleuze

Next week's #1: Vacra or Tiakola? Comment 1 or 2.
